title: Combine
description: Chunky toy-like green combine harvester: big lugged drive wheels at the front, small steering wheels at the back, cab with glass and a yellow roof, open-top grain tank with a scalable grain heap, folded unloading spout on a Y pivot, engine and exhaust at the back. No header (header.glb hangs on Socket_Header). Material `paint` is repainted per player.
checks: BACK tile (the chase camera's view): reads as a combine - tall boxy body, cab with glass up front on top, open grain tank behind the cab, big front wheels and small rear wheels
LEFT tile: the front drive wheels are clearly bigger than the rear steering wheels, and all four touch the grid line
LEFT tile: the feeder house slopes from the body front down toward the ground at the front (where the header mounts)
3/4 tile: the grain tank is open on top with a golden grain mound inside, below the yellow lip
3/4 tile: the unloading spout lies folded along the left side above the body and runs past the back end
3/4 tile: a ladder climbs the left side to the cab deck, with yellow handrails on the deck
TOP tile: the cab is at the front end, the tank in the middle, the engine and exhaust at the back
